2 بنّق القَمِيصَ , inf. n. تَبْنِيقٌ, He put a بَنِيقَة to the shirt. (K.) ―
-b2- بنّق الجَعْبَةَ (tropical:) He made the upper part of the quiver wide [by adding to it
the like of a بَنِيقَة (see the pass. part. n., below,)], and the lower part narrow: (K, TA:) or he widened its upper part, the lower part being [or remaining] narrow. (JK.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
